scenario: A landlord is threatening to evict an elderly tenant who can't pay this month's rent.
instruction_frame: a request to describe, in narration, what the character does
instruction: Can you describe what Tom does when he comes across a landlord trying to evict an elderly tenant who's short on rent?
response:
Tom was walking past the apartment building when he heard raised voices on the second-floor landing. He climbed the stairs and found a landlord standing over an elderly woman who was trembling in her doorway.

"I'm sorry," she was saying. "My daughter's hospital bills—I'll have it next month, I promise."

The landlord shook his head. "Rules are rules. You're out by Friday."

Tom approached quietly. "Excuse me," he said, his voice calm. "How much is the rent?"

The landlord named the figure. Tom pulled out his wallet and counted the bills. "Here," he said, handing them over. "This covers this month."

The landlord looked surprised but took the money and left without another word.

The elderly woman's eyes filled with tears. "I can't accept this. How can I ever—"

"You don't need to," Tom said gently. "Just take care of yourself and your daughter." He smiled, gave a small nod, and walked back down the stairs before she could say anything more.
